summary: Neoagent is a Neovim (Lua) plugin for LLM coding agents. It has no standalone CLI, but its public Lua API (`require("neoagent").new(opts, { workspace })`, `agent:send`, `agent:subscribe`) supports headless use. The overlay installs a self-contained Neovim 0.11.4 plus rg/fd/git/curl, copies the repo to /opt/harness/src, and adds a small driver (/opt/harness/run_task.lua, run by the `neoagent-run` wrapper through `nvim --headless -l`). The driver sets up one Agent with the bundled tools (read/write/edit file, shell, grep, find, …) and a custom `openai-completions` provider whose base_url is $PROXY_URL/v1. It sends $TASK once, waits for the Agent's `finish` update, prints assistant text and tool calls to stdout, and writes the Session JSONL, HTTP recordings, and result.json under /out. Model calls go out as streaming OpenAI chat-completions requests through curl.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=buildpack-deps:jammy
FROM ${BASE}
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git ripgrep fd-find xz-utils \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ARG NVIM_VERSION=v0.11.4
RUN set -eux; \
    case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|amd64) a=x86_64 ;; aarch64|arm64) a=arm64 ;; *) echo "unsupported arch"; exit 1 ;; esac; \
    mkdir -p /opt/harness/bin; \
    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/neovim/neovim/releases/download/${NVIM_VERSION}/nvim-linux-${a}.tar.gz" -o /tmp/nvim.tgz; \
    tar -xzf /tmp/nvim.tgz -C /opt/harness; \
    mv /opt/harness/nvim-linux-${a} /opt/harness/nvim; \
    rm /tmp/nvim.tgz; \
    ln -sf "$(command -v fdfind || command -v fd)" /opt/harness/bin/fd; \
    /opt/harness/nvim/bin/nvim --version | head -1
COPY . /opt/harness/src
COPY <<'EOF' /opt/harness/run_task.lua
-- Headless single-task driver for Neoagent; uses only its public Lua API.
local task = os.getenv("TASK") or ""
if task == "" then
  io.stderr:write("TASK is empty\n")
  os.exit(2)
end
local base_url = (os.getenv("NEOAGENT_BASE_URL") or ((os.getenv("PROXY_URL") or "") .. "/v1")):gsub("/+$", "")
local model_id = os.getenv("NEOAGENT_MODEL") or "gpt-4o"
local out_dir = os.getenv("NEOAGENT_OUT_DIR") or "/out"
local timeout_ms = tonumber(os.getenv("NEOAGENT_TIMEOUT_MS") or "") or 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000
local have_out = vim.fn.isdirectory(out_dir) == 1 or vim.fn.mkdir(out_dir, "p") == 1

local function log(s)
  io.stdout:write(s .. "\n")
  io.stdout:flush()
end
local function inline(v)
  return vim.inspect(v, { newline = " ", indent = "" })
end

local agent = require("neoagent").new({
  name = "Neo",
  default_registry = false,
  providers = {
    proxy = {
      api = "openai-completions",
      base_url = base_url,
      api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY") or "proxy",
      models = {
        [model_id] = { input = { "text" }, context_window = 200000, max_output_tokens = 32000 },
      },
    },
  },
  default_model = { provider = "proxy", model = model_id },
  tools = require("neoagent.tools").all({ shell_timeout = 600 }),
  workspace_trust = false,
  persistence = have_out and { enabled = true, workspace_settings = false, directory = out_dir .. "/sessions" }
    or { enabled = false },
  recording = have_out and { enabled = true, format = "json", retention = "all", directory = out_dir .. "/recordings" }
    or nil,
}, { workspace = vim.fn.getcwd() })

local result
agent:subscribe(function(update)
  if update.type == "event" then
    local ev = update.event
    if ev.type == "message_end" and ev.message and ev.message.role == "assistant" then
      for _, block in ipairs(type(ev.message.content) == "table" and ev.message.content or {}) do
        if block.type == "text" and block.text and block.text ~= "" then
          log("[assistant] " .. block.text)
        end
      end
    elseif ev.type == "tool_start" and ev.call then
      log("[tool] " .. tostring(ev.call.name) .. " " .. inline(ev.call.arguments))
    end
  elseif update.type == "finish" then
    result = update.result
  end
end)

local started, err = agent:send(task)
if not started then
  log("send failed: " .. inline(err))
  os.exit(1)
end
if not vim.wait(timeout_ms, function() return result ~= nil end, 200) then
  log("timed out; stopping")
  agent:stop()
  vim.wait(10000, function() return result ~= nil end, 100)
end
log("[finish] " .. inline(result))
if have_out then
  local f = io.open(out_dir .. "/result.json", "w")
  if f then
    f:write(vim.json.encode(result or { ok = false, status = "timeout" }))
    f:close()
  end
end
pcall(agent.destroy, agent)
os.exit(result and result.ok and 0 or 1)
EOF
COPY <<'EOF' /opt/harness/bin/neoagent-run
#!/bin/sh
exec /opt/harness/nvim/bin/nvim --headless -u NONE -i NONE -n \
  --cmd 'set runtimepath^=/opt/harness/src' -l /opt/harness/run_task.lua "$@"
EOF
RUN chmod +x /opt/harness/bin/neoagent-run
ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/nvim/bin:$PATH
check_command: nvim --headless -u NONE -i NONE -n --cmd 'set rtp^=/opt/harness/src' -c 'lua require("neoagent"); require("neoagent.tools").all(); io.stdout:write("neoagent ok\n")' -c 'qa!' && command -v neoagent-run rg fd git curl
notes:
I built and tested this locally. The image built on buildpack-deps:jammy (arm64). Against a stub OpenAI streaming server, the agent received 8 tools, ran a shell tool call, wrote the file in the task's cwd, finished with exit 0, and wrote sessions/, recordings/ and result.json under /out. It also works when the cwd is not a git repo (/app) and when /out is not mounted. The check command passes.

Details:
- Neoagent has no CLI of its own. The driver is not part of the repo; it is baked into the Dockerfile as a heredoc and uses only the documented public Lua API, so the harness source is unchanged. Heredoc COPY needs BuildKit (Docker 23+ default).
- A custom provider with `openai-completions` is used because the built-in `openai` provider uses the Responses API and model discovery, which the proxy may not serve. The model name is arbitrary (default gpt-4o) and is sent as-is.
- `workspace_trust = false` turns off the interactive trust prompt. Direct compositions also have no approval policy, because `execute_tool` is unset. The native sandbox is off by default.
- The tools are `tools.all()`: read_file, write_file, edit_file, shell (600s timeout), grep, find, read_agent_documentation and update_plan. They need rg and fd; on Ubuntu, fd comes from fd-find and is symlinked to /opt/harness/bin/fd.
- Outputs: the Session trajectory is at /out/sessions/<ws>/sessions/<id>.jsonl, HTTP recordings are at /out/recordings (JSON, retention=all), and the final status is in /out/result.json. The exit code is 0 only when the Run succeeds.
- The default wall-clock limit is 3h; override it with NEOAGENT_TIMEOUT_MS. Retries use the defaults (3, starting at a 2s delay).
